name: SOFT_EDGES_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q05 'Soft edges' warning sign (1995/2016, rev B). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Legend two lines f 120D (Series D, cap 120), gap d 60 between the lines, e 15 from the bottom of SOFT down to the horizontal centreline (the same chain as W5-Q04: f / e to the centreline, d across it / f): SOFT cap top 424.27 - 15 - 120 = 289.27, EDGES cap top 409.27 + 60 = 469.27. Black on retroreflective yellow. 2026-10-02 audit: the e 15 span was misread: on the sheet e runs from the horizontal centreline DOWN to the top of EDGES (the centreline lies inside the d 60 gap, 45 below SOFT and 15 above EDGES), so the cap tops are 424.27 - 45 - 120 = 259.27 and 424.27 + 15 = 439.27 (were 289.27 / 469.27, 30 too low, EDGES ran into the border).
